title: Resistor Drawing MicroSim
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating resistor circuit symbols with different resistance values in horizontal and vertical orientations
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Resistor Symbols
Circuit Diagrams
Electrical Components
Resistance
Ohm's Law
learningObjectives: Identify the US-style resistor symbol by its six-peak zig-zag pattern and distinguish it from the inductor's coil and the capacitor's plates
Explain how a resistor limits current, and use Ohm's law to predict which of 220 ohms, 1K, 10K, or 100K passes the most current at a fixed voltage
Compare resistance values expressed in ohms, kilohms, and megohms and convert between the three units
Draw correctly proportioned resistor symbols with value labels in both horizontal and vertical orientations
